body:
The C2 quiet window is OPEN as of 19:50 MST. The ship queue is empty, and nothing else ships until the STORY-1728 stack lands. That includes #2750, which I'm holding behind you. main will not move under you.

Do this now:
1. #2727: merge origin/main, run check-ci-fast + test-touched + check-ci-compile, push, and mark it ready (`gh pr ready 2727`). I review on green CI and ship immediately.
2. After #2727 merges: retarget #2730 to main, merge main, push, mark it ready. Same for #2751. Each slice needs its own attested PASS (17:30 ruling (3)).
3. The Early/no-store and team_identity parity tests (17:30 ruling (2a)/(2c)) must be in the slice that introduces them.

Reply on this thread when #2727 is pushed.
subject: C2 QUIET WINDOW OPEN NOW for STORY-1728
